description.p: 3DxLinux (tdxd) drives 3Dconnexion 3D mice on Linux: the SpacePilot PRO, SpaceMouse Enterprise, SpaceMouse Pro and Wireless, and others. It moves the view in spacenavd-compatible applications such as Blender and FreeCAD, sends the keys' shortcuts, and runs the LCD and LEDs.

3Dconnexion Settings sets the speed, axes and buttons, per application, like the Windows control panel; the LCD Manager runs the Function Keys, RSS Feeds and Picture Viewer applets on the SpacePilot PRO's display. 3Dconnexion's key settings for each application and its artwork can be imported from your own 3DxWare installer.
3DxLinux is an independent driver, not a 3Dconnexion product.
